title: Natural Grocers® Launches On-Demand Delivery Nationwide Through DoorDash
summary: Natural Grocers®, the nation's largest family-operated natural and organic grocery retailer, announces a new partnership with DoorDash, making grocery delivery available from all 174 Natural Grocers locations nationwide.

title: Natural Grocers® Invites Customers to Celebrate Labor Day with Special Deals, September 4-9, 2026
summary: Natural Grocers®, the nation's largest family-operated natural and organic grocery retailer, is helping customers stock up for the unofficial end of summer with its Even More AffordableSM Labor Day Deals. From Sept. 4–9, {N}power® members can enjoy savings of up to 51% on premium-quality products that will make those last bits of summer last in a delicious, affordable way.[i]

title: Natural Grocers® Marks Organic Month With Nationwide Fundraiser for Rodale Institute
summary: This Organic Month, Natural Grocers® is inviting customers to join a movement that extends far beyond the grocery aisle. Throughout September, the family-operated organic and natural retailer will raise funds for Rodale Institute's Farmer Training and Veteran Farmer Training programs. This ongoing partnership with Rodale Institute helps equip future regenerative organic farmers with the skills needed to grow healthy food, restore soil health and strengthen local communities.

title: Natural Grocers® Hosts Virtual Hiring Event for Los Alamos, New Mexico Location on August 27, 2026
summary: Natural Grocers®, the nation's largest family-operated organic and natural grocery retailer, is hosting a virtual hiring event for a variety of positions available at its Los Alamos store located at 1501 Trinity Dr., Los Alamos, NM 87544. Available opportunities include cashiers, department management and store leadership roles. The company offers competitive pay, career growth opportunities and comprehensive benefits.
